A continuous soft scattering gradient fills the entire frame including the foreground, thickening slightly with distance. Gentle bloom at the window only. NO FOG, NO MIST, NO SMOKE IN THE AIR, no volumetric shafts, no god rays, no visible light beams, no drifting particulate and no dust motes anywhere at any depth — light lands on surfaces and never becomes visible in the space it crosses. NO PURE BLACK ANYWHERE AT ANY DEPTH.

NO PEOPLE ANYWHERE IN THE FRAME — the room is empty, and there is no figure, no silhouette, no shadow of a person and no reflection of a person in the leaning mirror or anywhere else at any depth. NO ON-SCREEN TEXT of any kind — no titles, no captions, no watermarks, no logos, no annotations and no lettering burned into the image anywhere. The three framed pictures on the wall render as abstract mark-making with no legible characters, and the books on the nightstand carry no legible titles on their spines or covers.
